articles.headline: Inside the abrupt ending to A'ja Wilson's historic MVP season
articles.description: The WNBA Finals will be without five-time MVP A'ja Wilson and the Aces. The script flipped suddenly on the defending champs.

images.name: A'ja Wilson [1296x729]
images.caption: Five-time MVP A'ja Wilson and the Aces were denied a repeat on Friday when they were swept by the Valkyries in the semifinals.
images.alt: A'ja Wilson

images.name: A'ja Wilson MVP [800x800]
images.caption: Wilson won her fifth MVP trophy after averaging 26.2 points per game this season.
images.alt: A'ja Wilson MVP

images.name: A'ja Wilson [800x450]
images.caption: Wilson's march to her fifth MVP included a 38-point game against Shakira Austin and the Mystics in July.
images.alt: A'ja Wilson

images.name: A'ja Wilson [800x450]
images.caption: Wilson has amassed a collection of trophies, titles and medals during her career. She even has a statue.
images.alt: A'ja Wilson

images.name: A'ja Wilson [800x450]
images.caption: Wilson confronted a fan in the stands in Indiana, and the Aces managed just one more win before their season came to an end.
images.alt: A'ja Wilson

images.name: A'ja Wilson [1296x864]
images.caption: Wilson wasn't at her best on Friday night, but she vowed she'd be back.
